tasks.title: Conversation #27
tasks.transcript:
Man: Kirin, have you read this book, "Creating beautiful jewelry" ?
Woman: Yeah. I read it last year. It was required for a course I took on jewelry design.
Man: I want to take a course on that too, but it may not work with my schedule. Should I buy the book anyway? I'm not sure when I would have time to read it."
Woman: Why not? You can always return it if you decide you don't want it."
Man: You think I'll get a full refund if I do that?"
Woman: Yes, but only if you don't make any notes in it."

questions.stem: What does the woman say she did last year?

options.A: She read a book about making jewelry.
options.C: She returned a purchase to a bookstore.
options.D: She wrote notes about a design show.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士说她去年做了什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对自己过去经历的明确陈述。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士问女士是否读过《Creating beautiful jewelry》这本书，女士回答“Yeah. I read it last year. It was required for a course I took on jewelry design.”，说明她去年读了一本关于制作珠宝的书。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到女士上过珠宝设计课程，但并未说她创办了珠宝生意，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 对话中女士建议男士可以把书退掉，但并未说她去年退过东西，属于张冠李戴。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到设计展，女士只提到了读书和课程，属于与原文无关的干扰项。

options.A: The man should wait to purchase the book.
options.B: The man should avoid writing in the book.
options.C: The man should compare different bookstores' prices.
options.D: The man should talk to the bookstore manager.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士推荐了什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对男士问题的具体建议。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士建议男士可以买这本书（Why not?），而不是让他等一等再买，属于与原文意思相反。 选项B：正确。 男士问是否能全额退款，女士回答“Yes, but only if you don't make any notes in it.”，说明她建议男士不要在书上做笔记，这样才能保证全额退款。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到比较不同书店的价格，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 女士没有建议男士去找书店经理谈话，她只提到了退款的注意事项。
